chalisa.do1: Having worshipped Gaṇapati and fixed my mind on the Guru's feet, I joyfully write the Chālīsā of Pretarāja.
chalisa.do2: Victory, victory to the mighty lord of spirits, who takes away the whole burden of sorrow. Victory, victory to Pretarāja Sarkār, crest-jewel of heroes.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory to Pretarāja, purifier of the world, most mighty, destroyer of the three afflictions. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: You are a formidable hero, an ocean of compassion, the remover of your devotees' sufferings and a storehouse of every virtue. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: A throne studded with gems shines; seeing it and hearing of it, men and sages are enchanted at heart. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: A lovely, glittering crown is on your head; the earrings in your ears are most pleasing to the mind. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: You bear a bow, a sword, arrows and a spear; you are in a warrior's attire, and your brows are most fearsome. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: You ride an elephant, with a great army beside you; martial drums and mṛdaṅgas sound. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: The royal umbrella, the fly-whisk and the fan are waved over your head; hosts of devotees together cry victory, victory. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: You are the crest-jewel of devotees and a fierce hero; your mighty arms, which crush the wicked, shine. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: When your army marches, even the earth trembles; the sight of you wipes away even the filth of the Kali age. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Coming to Ghāṭā Mehandipur, Pretarāja, ocean of virtues, appeared there. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: A red flag flies in the sky; devotees dance, rapt within their hearts. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: You are the master who fulfils devotees' desires, the renowned servant of Bajaraṅgī, Hanumān. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: You fulfil wishes and remove every sorrow and trouble. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Whoever comes with whatever wish, they all obtain the fruit their hearts desire. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: The sick who come to serve you soon go home well. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Ghosts, piśācas, jinns and vetālas flee on seeing your fearsome form. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: All pains caused by other beings and all pains of the body you quickly remove, as your sport. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: However many hard tasks there are in the world, all are accomplished by repeating your name. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Those who serve with body, mind and wealth have all their sufferings taken away by the Lord. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: O my compassionate master, I lie at your feet. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: I have no one but you; Lord, you are my one refuge. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: My honour is in your hands; I lie here with your feet as my support. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Whoever pleads in this way with body and mind, all disease and sorrow leave his body. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: You have taken incarnation at Mehandipur and taken away your devotees' sorrow. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: The sick, those with an afflicted mind, the childless, those troubled by spirits, those without a son and without wealth: ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: all who come to your door go home with the fruit their hearts desire. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Your glory has spread over the earth; devotees have sung of your divine play. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: The ascetic Mahant Gaṇeśapurī worships you, offering up his body and mind. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Burly messengers stand there, holding maces and cudgels in their hands. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Their bodies are red, with vermilion upon them; the spirits in the shrine tremble and shake. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Whoever recites the Pretarāja Chālīsā twenty-one times every day, ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: bathes you in the early morning and applies oil and vermilion, ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: offers sandal paste, perfume and scented oil, and puts a garland of flowers on you, ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: waves the āratī with camphor, prays and calls out your victory, ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: all their sufferings are cut away, and they go home happy. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: You fulfil the wish of your devotee; the desire of his heart is fulfilled. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: You remove your devotees' sufferings and destroy the host of enemies; when one meditates on you, all sins are shed. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Victory, victory, victory to the lord of spirits, victory. Victory to the king, remover of distress, victory. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: When a man reads the Preta Chālīsā, not the least trace of sorrow ever remains with him. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: The devotee says: meditate in your mind on the holy feet of Pretarāja. ॥40॥
chalisa.do3: Crusher of the wicked, remover of the world's sins, queller of all the pangs of worldly existence: victory to Pretarāja, the mighty protector of devotees, the root of happiness.
chalisa.do4: Son of Añjanī, of pure attire, and Pretarāja, abode of strength, dwell ever in my heart, says the devotee Sukharāma.
